d: Courtyard in the Palazzo d'Alcina. Angelica and Alcina.
Alcina, then Orlando with face trod with Astolfo, and pressing him.
Delightful garden where you can see the two sources, one of which extinguishes, the other igniting love. Stormy sea far away. Angelica, then Medoro wounded coming from the sea.
Delicious wood with vegetable pickups. Alcina and Astolfo.
Montuosa alpestre with high, and steep cliffs. Angelica, Medoro.
The cliff is rushing into a horrid cave, and nowhere is the exit of it. Orlando only in the cave.
Campaign at the foot of a hill with grove on the sides, in the shade of which I saw apparatus of pots, and the wedding cup of Angelica, and Medoro. Angelica, Medoro, Alcina, Chorus.
Orlando, who comes and sees Angelica and Medoro leave.
Vestibule ahead of the temple of Hecate Hell with a steel wall in a façade that closes the temple itself. Astolfo and Ruggiero.
Ruggiero, then Bradamante in man's dress.
Orlando, Alcina, Bradamante and Ruggiero aside.
I would roar alone, then Medoro.
Alcina, Orlando, sleeping, then Bradamante and Ruggiero.
Angelica and Medoro fugitives and sayings.
Astolfo with Soldati of Logistilla, one of which carries a lighted face and sayings.
